what: The installed plugin's stock gateway route, run against a real gateway on a clean stock Windows install. No accounts were read or changed.
machine: Hyper-V test machine switcher-test, Windows 11 Pro 25H2 build 26200, Hermes installed by a normal signed-in user with the official source script
gateway_started_by: Hermes's own launcher, from a normal-user session; login auto-start registered as scheduled task Hermes_Gateway

earlier_failed_run_same_day.result: FAILED SwitchError: The Hermes gateway did not start.
earlier_failed_run_same_day.cause: gateway commands were run as `python -m hermes_cli.main gateway start`; the spawned gateway exited with 'no dependency environment is committed for this install'. Hermes reported the failure in text with exit code 0.
earlier_failed_run_same_day.fix: gateway commands now go through Hermes's own launcher (bin/hermes.exe); stock health is read from the gateway's ledger because stock serves no health endpoint on port 8642

not_covered: a real account switch (no accounts are enrolled on the test machine)
a gateway started by the switch worker while Hermes Desktop closes
the Hermes Desktop interface: plugin badge, dialog, enablement
a Hermes update between two builds
the packaged Desktop app (MSIX) install route
